# Roger Bisschoff — STR Commercial Strategy

Roger Bisschoff is an independent commercial advisor for short-term rental (STR) and serviced apartment operators, focused on identifying and recovering hidden commercial margin leakage — across distribution/OTA economics, rate and pricing, owner acquisition and retention, direct bookings, technology-stack cost versus yield, and portfolio-level profitability. This site also hosts nine free diagnostic tools built by Roger as supporting evidence of his method, not as the primary product. Each tool answers one specific question about an operator's commercial performance — distribution costs, owner retention, guest experience, repeat guest value, or unit profitability — and turns it into a measurable number. All tools run entirely in the browser: no login, no account, and no data leaves the visitor's device. Start with the Operator Diagnostic (a 2-minute, six-question screen) to identify which specific tool to use next.

The site also publishes commercial Insights (rogerbisschoff.com/insights/) as they come up, demonstrating Roger's commercial thinking and domain expertise. There is no "Operator Analyzer" public tool or public API — it is an internal research tool Roger uses himself, not a public product. The nine diagnostic tools named above are the complete public catalogue.
